description: Designer clothes, shoes and bags marked down right now at independent luxury boutiques, each with its old price, the price now, how much is off, the sizes in stock, the shop and the shopwithin.co page to buy it. Use this when someone asks for a designer sale, designer deals or a designer outlet, designer clothes on sale, a price drop, one brand on sale ("Canada Goose sale", "Rick Owens sale"), a kind of item on sale, or Black Friday and Cyber Monday prices. It narrows by designer, kind, women's or men's, size, boutique, city and a price cap, and gives within's sale page or Black Friday page for the designer when there is one. It only knows what the boutiques on within have marked down today.

boutiques.description: Boutique domains to read, as shown on boutiques and items (e.g. 'wdlt117.myshopify.com').

categories.description: Kinds of item in plain words: 'jackets', 'hats', 'shorts', 'sneakers', 'bags', 'shoes'.

city.description: The city the boutiques are in, e.g. 'Toronto': a place to shop, not the shopper's own location.

department.description: Women's or men's. Items made for anyone stay in.

designers.description: Designer or brand names: 'Canada Goose', 'Stussy', 'Rick Owens'.

offset.description: Items to skip; use next_offset from the page before.

order.description: biggest_drop (the default): the biggest markdown first. lowest_price: the cheapest first. newest: among the marked-down items, the ones that arrived at the boutiques last come first.

price_max.description: Highest price now, in the boutique's currency.

sizes.description: Sizes that must be in stock, as the shops label them: 'M', '42', 'US 9', 'IT 38'.

name: on_sale
title: On sale now
